item_scrap_steel.name: Scrap Steel
item_scrap_steel.description: Warped strips of pre-collapse structural steel. The backbone of every forge-yard in Berkshire.

item_salvaged_spring.name: Salvaged Spring
item_salvaged_spring.description: A coiled steel spring yanked from old machinery. Still holds tension. Useful for mechanisms and traps.

item_blight_moss.name: Blight Moss
item_blight_moss.description: Fluorescent green moss that colonises irradiated ground. Mildly toxic raw, but a key reagent in field-grade salves.
